how_to_apply: Download the application form, which is on pages 3 and 4 of the official notification PDF.
Fill in the post(s) you are applying for, say whether you are applying for Project I, Project II or both, and paste a recent passport-size photograph.
Complete your personal details, educational qualifications (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post-Graduation), your experience in date order and any other research experience. Then sign the declaration.
Report on Friday, 6 November 2026 to Class Room No. 3, Department of Public Administration, First Floor, Arts Block 3, Sector 14, Panjab University, Chandigarh 160014.
Hand in the filled form when you report, no later than 01.00 p.m.

Incomplete forms, and applications not in the given format, may be rejected without further review. Once you have submitted the form, requests to change it will not be considered. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
Self-attested copies of the mark sheets and certificates for all qualifications, plus your experience certificate and publications if you have them, attached as enclosures to the form

content_sections.heading: About Panjab University
content_sections.text: Panjab University is a university in Chandigarh. Its Department of Public Administration and its University Business School are hiring this staff for projects funded by the Climate Compatible Growth Project (CCG), Center for Global Equality, Cambridge, U.K.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the Department of Public Administration. Any experience, publications or technical skills you claim must be backed by documents where applicable. The University may check eligibility and original documents before it finalises the selection. Canvassing in any form, or bringing political or other influence, will disqualify the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary. The PI decides how many days, and on which dates, the selected staff will actually be employed. The durations in the vacancy tables are upper limits. Payment is made per day worked. The declaration on the form says that if a candidate is found to have hidden or distorted any material information, the engagement can be ended at once without notice.

faq.question: Q1. How much does each post pay per day?
faq.answer: A Research Associate gets Rs. 1500 a day, a Research Assistant/Junior Research Fellow gets Rs. 1200 a day and an Intern gets Rs. 500 a day.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply for an internship while I am still doing my Master's?
faq.answer: Yes. The Intern post accepts a Master's that is completed or ongoing, in Public Administration, Management or Commerce.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts need knowledge of OSeMOSYS and CLEWS?
faq.answer: The Research Associate post and the Research Assistant/Junior Research Fellow post under Project II both need it. The Project I Research Assistant/JRF post does not list it.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply for both projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The application form asks you to mark Project I, Project II or both.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the engagement last?
faq.answer: The limits are up to 80 days for the Project I Research Assistant/JRF, up to 100 days for the Research Associate, up to 120 days for the Project II Research Assistant/JRF, and 24 and 45 days in total for the Interns of Project I and Project II. The PI decides the actual number of days.

faq.question: Q6. Where exactly is the interview venue?
faq.answer: Class Room No. 3, First Floor, Arts Block 3, Sector 14, Panjab University, Chandigarh 160014. This is in the Department of Public Administration.

faq.question: Q7. Will I get travel allowance for attending?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who can I contact with questions?
faq.answer: For Project I, write to Prof. Suveera Gill at [email protected]. For Project II, write to Dr. Bhawna Gupta at [email protected].
